subject: IR playbook execution and SIG deliverables for third-party scan findings
messages:
From: Alice Liang <alice.liang@greenbank.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: security@greenbank.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Suspicious SSO activity — immediate ask + SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Hi Marissa,

We ran a routine third-party risk scan and flagged a cluster of anomalous SSO logins to our staging tenant that appear to originate from a small set of IPs. This looks like an attempted credential stuffing event; we do not yet see data exfiltration but need to confirm.

Can you:
- Confirm Redwood's incident response process and point us to the IR playbook you will execute if we escalate?
- Provide a short list of SIG/CAIQ/SOC2 artifacts we can expect (e.g., runbooks, timeline, evidence exports) for our internal risk team to evaluate?
- Share any immediate mitigations you can enable on your side while we coordinate (IP blocks, increased MFA enforcement, token rotation windows).

We'd like a quick sync today if possible — 30 minutes. I can do 10:30am PT.

Thanks,
Alice
Senior Risk Analyst
GreenBank Financial

Attachments: none (we will send a sample log excerpt in a follow-up)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Liang <alice.liang@greenbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 7 Sep 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Suspicious SSO activity — immediate ask + SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Alice — thanks for flagging this and for the heads-up. Short answers up front: we will execute the IR playbook scoped to customer-impacting auth anomalies, and we can produce a SIG/CAIQ evidence packet tailored to your audit team (runbooks, SSO telemetry, retention statements, SOC2 control mapping).

Immediate next steps we propose:
- Convene a 30-min triage call at 10:30am PT (joining: me, Karthik from infra, Laura from compliance).
- We'll pre-stage the IR checklist and start a scoped log export for the window you provide.
- Temporary mitigations we can enable now: block the listed IPs at our edge for your tenant, force token invalidation for affected sessions, and tighten MFA for service accounts.

I've attached our IR_Checklist_v1.pdf for your review — it shows playbook steps, communication cadence, and evidence we collect. On the call we'll confirm scope and what to share back.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: IR_Checklist_v1.pdf (pdf)

-Karthik

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Liang <alice.liang@greenbank.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 9 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Postmortem & SIG/CAIQ deliverables — GB staging auth anomalies (2026-09-07)

Alice — thanks again for the triage call earlier. We ran the playbook scoped to gb-staging-3 and here's what we are delivering now: 

Summary:
- Event: credential stuffing attempts against multiple service accounts in your staging tenant on 2026-09-07 02:00–05:00 UTC.
- Impact: transient unauthorized logins observed; no production/customer data accessed; all affected sessions were invalidated and we rotated service tokens for impacted service accounts.
- Root cause: broad credential spray targeting low-privilege service accounts with reused credentials.

Artifacts attached/shared: 
- redwood_postmortem_20260909.pdf — timeline, scope, remediation steps, lessons learned.
- forensics_snippet.json — event timeline and hashed log excerpts (suitable for your audit team).
- SIG/CAIQ packet — mapping of our runbook sections to SIG questions and the SOC2 control IDs (shared to your secure Drive link).

Actions we took:
- Blocked offending IPs at our edge for your tenant (temporary, will lift after 30 days unless you request extension).
- Forced session invalidation and token rotation for impacted service accounts.
- Increased MFA and tightened rate limits for authentication endpoints on the staging tenant.
- Provided a recommended password rotation and service-account hardening checklist for GreenBank.

Next steps / asks for GreenBank:
- Confirm receipt of the postmortem PDF and the forensics snippet.
- Confirm whether you want the temporary IP block extended beyond 30 days.
- If you need an expanded SOC2/SIG artifact package (signed control matrix or auditor-facing exports) please tell us which items and we'll provide an estimated delivery date.

I've uploaded all files to the secure Drive folder (link below) and opened JIRA SEC-3421 to track any remaining artifacts. Laura, marking this resolved in the compliance tracker; please escalate if the audit team requests additional documentation.

Link: https://drive.redwood.com/secure/GreenBank-IR/Playbook
JIRA: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SEC-3421

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_postmortem_20260909.pdf, forensics_snippet.json
